QUOTE: "Explicit beats declared, wholesale. ... that value replaces the `.clew.yaml` value for that option. It does not merge with it." and "Facts that someone already wrote down are never removed." / "Tier-3 and tier-4 values survive every stated tier. A declaration cannot remove a macro that the Doxyfile defines."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says stated tiers replace each other wholesale while discovered tier-3/4 facts accumulate and survive every stated value, which is the asymmetry the item describes.
